name: Gorkanaut

bonuses.name: Big 'n' Stompy
bonuses.text: When the Gorkanaut Charges it can move through any Huge or smaller individuals, forcing them to make a DN 2 Agility Test or suffer 1d6 Mortal Wounds.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 3 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

bonuses.name: Transport
bonuses.text: If you are using the rules for vehicles from Church of Steel, a Gorkanaut has 1 Nob Pilot, 1 Nob Crew, and space for 6 Passengers.

weapons.name: Klaw of Gork (or possibly Mork): Crush
Klaw of Gork (or possibly Mork): Smash

abilities.name: Klaw of Gork (or possibly Mork)
abilities.text: Each time an attack is made with this weapon the Gorkanaut can Crush once, or Smash 3 times without suffering a Multi-attack penalty to DN.

abilities.name: Explosive
abilities.text: When a Gorkanaut dies, roll a d6. If you roll a Complication, the Gorkanaut explodes. Gorkanaut Explosion: 18 +6 ED / Blast (15)

note: Print errors, copied as printed: Determination "roll 124d6"; Skorcha prints "Salvo 2 – /" (stray dash, stored as salvo 2). Resilience prints "17(AR 4)"; Rokkit Launcha prints "(6)", stored as count 6.
